title: Kenny Omega: the Belt Collector
summary: Omega and Callis connect AEW’s world-title scene with Impact, before Christian Cage starts taking championships away.

chapters.title: Omega and Callis announce their next stop
chapters.result: New AEW champion Omega leaves with Callis, who promises answers on Impact.

chapters.title: Christian takes the Impact championship
chapters.result: Christian defeats Omega for the Impact World Championship.
chapters.context: An AEW television match dents the Belt Collector’s collection.

chapters.title: Omega keeps the AEW title
chapters.result: Omega defeats Christian in the AEW world-title rematch.
chapters.context: Christian cannot repeat his Rampage victory for AEW’s championship.
